description.en: Contribution rate for the State Pension Insurance (Algemene Ouderdomswet, AOW), the largest of the three Dutch 'people's insurance' contributions levied on Box 1 taxable income (alongside ANW and AWBZ/WLZ). Like the other peoplesic rates it is applied as a band_rate in peoplesic_nl/SchedCalc, and reused in bsagross_nl for the revised-contribution ArithOp, the tax-credit apportionment BenCalc, and the $bsag_fact net-to-gross conversion-factor DefConst. Per the country report (Table 2.24 - the constant label's reference to 'Table 2.23' appears to be a cross-reference to a different table), the rate was 17.9% throughout 2022-2025 and is not charged to persons who have reached state pension age, since they no longer build up AOW entitlement.

explanation.en: EUROMOD function group: contribution rates and maximum base peoples' insurances
